The report highlights how severe flooding around Lake Victoria forces families off ancestral lands, destroying local traditions and overwhelming schools.

Communities in Nduru and Sango Rota face permanent displacement, loss of livelihoods, and systemic institutional failure to manage basin waters.

The Unavoidable Truth: Wetland destruction and climate change are actively displacing vulnerable shoreline communities.

The Unavoidable Lie: Regional water commissions have fully contained the seasonal flooding of Lake Victoria.
